help_panel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE empty vertical game modal panel sprite with genuine transparent background. Do not copy the long horizontal button; this is a nearly square vertically taller PANEL with softly rounded corners exactly like the popup. Front-facing camera, no tilted perspective, straight edges.
